heuristics.name: distinctive/specific word
heuristics.description: Pick the option most specific or vivid, the one that seems written to fit a particular context while others are generic fillers

heuristics.name: two-blank internal coherence/contrast
heuristics.description: For two-blank items pick the pair whose halves form a natural contrast or cause relation; repeated first word (L49) as tell

heuristics.name: elevated vocabulary
heuristics.description: Prefer the harder/rarer word in a vocabulary test

notes: No option was certain to reject without the stem; most items felt like near-guesses.
